name: Fire my Laser

features.name: Bombs and Lasers
features.description: Destroy symbols, which pay out as they're removed.

features.name: Chain reactions
features.description: One blast can set off others.

features.name: Total Win Bar
features.description: Collects the spin's winnings and pays at the end.

review:
No normal wins at all. Bombs and lasers blow up symbols, and every paying symbol destroyed pays from the paytable – blanks pay nothing. Destroyed symbols cause cascades, and new bombs and lasers can be set off by other explosions.

Everything goes into a Total Win Bar, paid at the end of the spin, with bombs and lasers firing in a set order. A sci-fi demolition game and one of the strangest designs in the catalogue. 15,000x max.
